tools.name: search_conversions
tools.description: RAD public housing conversions from HUD's RAD Resource Desk export, newest first: project, housing authority, state, PBV or PBRA, units, status, CHAP and closing dates, tax credits (4%/9%), FHA insurance and Section 18 blend flags, with each housing authority's rad.loans page.

tools.name: get_housing_authority
tools.description: A public housing authority's RAD record: closed conversions (units, PBV/PBRA, tax credits, FHA), deals between CHAP and closing, remaining public housing units and their weighted 2026 RAD rent, and its conversions list. Give the HUD PHA code (IL002), the rad.loans page URL, or name + state.

tools.name: get_rad_program_facts
tools.description: The current state of RAD law and terms, each with its primary source: permanence and the 555,000-unit cap (Public Law 119-101 section 212, July 2026), the governing notices, PBV and PBRA contract terms, FHA premium and underwriting, the 2026 LIHTC bond test, agency terms.

tools.name: get_financing_quote_link
tools.description: The page where a housing authority, developer or owner can request a financing quote for a RAD conversion, Section 18 blend, PRAC or Component 2 conversion, or a refinance of a converted property, from Janover Capital LLC. Optional prefill. Returns a link only; it submits nothing.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_housing_authority" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
